title: Pitch Looks Solid, Yet 9 Drops Took 84 Years
hook: Pitch looks solid, but one experiment recorded just 9 drops.
closing: Extreme patience can reveal movement that a normal experiment would completely miss.
question: Could you wait for one drop?

segments.say: Only 9 pitch drops were recorded. The experiment proves a solid-looking material can still flow.
Dublin waited 69 years for a filmed pitch drop. One result can outlast a researcher's career.
Pitch is 230 billion times more viscous than water. That is why its movement is almost invisible.
